artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene. It features a knight in armor riding a horse wearing barding. The knight is holding a broken jousting lance, and fragments of the lance are shown flying apart. The background includes a wooden barrier, indicating a jousting tournament setting.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a jousting scene. It depicts two armored figures on horseback engaging in a jousting match. Each figure is clad in armor, with one rider adorned with a helmet featuring a decorative sunburst. The horses are covered in green armor, and their dynamic poses suggest the motion of the joust. The scene is framed by a wooden barrier, indicating the arena setting. The drawing conveys the tension and action of medieval jousting through its detailed depiction of armor and horses. The muted color palette enhances the historical ambiance of the illustration.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over leadpoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored knights jousting on horseback. The scene depicts a medieval jousting match between two knights. Both knights are clad in ornate suits of armor and riding horses draped in checkered cloth. Each knight is equipped with a long lance, one of which is shown splintering against the other’s armor. The horses are posed on a wooden platform, which serves as an arena for the joust. The detailed embellishments on the horses' coverings and the knights' armors adds a sense of grandeur and historical authenticity to the illustration. The piece includes panels of script in an elegant, cursive style, adding to its medieval theme and reflecting elements of documentation or heraldry associated with such tournaments.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace

The scene captures the moment of impact between two knights, both clad in armor and seated on elaborately decorated horses with their lances meeting in the center. The knight on the left is draped in a blue checkered fabric, while the knight on the right is wearing red. The horses are equally adorned in matching colors. artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a knight unseated from his horse during a jousting scene. The knight, dressed in green and white striped armor, has fallen from his horse. The armor is detailed with a mix of plate metal and fabric. The knight is shown on the ground, legs bent underneath, with one arm reaching out. Above the fallen knight is a horse with a similarly colored caparison, mid-trot, with a broken lance. A cluster of greenery adorns the horse's headgear. The background features lined barriers, suggesting a tournament setting. The painting captures the drama and romance of medieval chivalric tournaments in the style of historical manuscript illustrations, with watercolor-like coloration and careful attention to detail.

artworks.title: Italian Joust of Peace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a jousting scene between two armor-clad competitors on horseback. The painting depicts a dynamic encounter, where two figures, clad in suits of armor, are mounted on horses in a jousting tournament. One rider, mounted on a dark reddish-brown horse, is shown in a forward-leaning motion, while another rider, astride a green horse, leans towards their opponent. Each horse appears to be elaborately adorned in colors to match their riders. The image captures the moment of impact as lances break upon contact, with fragments of wood and the tip of a lance flying through the air, emphasizing the intensity of the moment. Delicate details, such as the ornate crests atop the helmets and the careful line work, give a sense of authenticity and period flair. This is in the style of an early Renaissance or late Gothic artist.
